description: Source code for telemetry utility functions related to inter-chip communication, grep result retrieval, and configuration management in a platform-specific context (notably XB3).

methods.name: getInterChipDCAResult
methods.description: Retrieves DCA results from inter-chip communication, using inotify to monitor result file creation.

methods.name: sendDeleteProfileEvent
methods.description: Sends a delete profile event to the inter-chip communication system.

methods.name: saveGrepConfig
methods.description: Saves grep configuration to a file and notifies the inter-chip system to update.
